servicesIntro: From a single door ding to hail damage.

services.name: Paintless Dent Repair
services.text: Specialized tools and techniques remove most dents without impacting the paintwork.

services.name: Plastic Bumper Repair
services.text: Modern plastic bumpers cost a lot to replace. Our methods can eliminate or significantly cut the repair cost on most vehicles.

services.name: Vehicle Body Inspection
services.text: When we fix a visible dent, we also check the vehicle for other damage. It matters most when you turn in a lease vehicle.

why.name: Lower cost
why.text: A PDR repair can cost as little as 1/8 of a body shop repair. Nothing is replaced, only repaired.

why.name: No paint, no waste
why.text: Often a whole panel gets painted for one small dent. PDR fixes just that spot and leaves no paint debris.

why.name: Better for the environment
why.text: No paints or solvents means fewer chemicals and lower VOC emissions, and almost no energy use.

howTitle: Back to like new, step by step.

steps.name: Send the details
steps.text: Call, or use the form with your year, make, model and photos of the damage.

steps.name: Get an evaluation
steps.text: Bring the vehicle in and we look at the hail damage, dings or film options.

steps.name: Drive it smooth
steps.text: We work the dents out and hand the vehicle back.
